title: feat(runtime): /ready reports cluster driver health when multi-replica is declared (#3814)
body:
epic:#3814#1 · os-zhuang · session_01QUs3BrVu5TqwtmuhsjdEvM
Filing gate: ③ maintainer-dispatched task (child of #3814). Maintainer, (2026-11-08, 16:25 UTC): 「继续，现在派第二批」 (gate 1 after the card 0 inventory, cloud#3868 comment 6723322368).

Parent: #3814 (rulings R0-R6 on comment 6722625146).

## Problem (smoke, card 0; fable plan review #6)
`/ready` checks only the primary datasource. With Redis stopped, a replica's `/ready` stayed 200 throughout, and an operator has no signal that the cluster has lost coordination.

## Do
1. When multi-replica is declared on the Redis driver, `/ready` includes the cluster driver's health (from F3a's health seam, or a ping if F3a is not merged) and, when Redis is down, answers **200 with `status: degraded`** and a `cluster` entry naming the driver as unreachable. PM decision D4 (2026-11-08): not 503. Every replica loses Redis together, so 503 would turn a degraded cluster into a total outage while the DB is still the source of truth.
2. Single node: body and status byte-identical to today.
3. Tests: declared + Redis down = 200 degraded with the cluster entry; declared + Redis up = 200 ok; single node unchanged; the stopping (SIGTERM) 503 path unchanged.

## Rules that bind every #3814 child (verbatim rulings on the parent)
R1 peer round-robin. R2 Redis required for multi-replica only. R3 「同意：每张卡都只在"声明多副本并接上 Redis 驱动"时才生效」: the single-node default path is unchanged, multi-replica behaviour switches on only behind declared replicas>1 AND a connected Redis cluster driver, the split-brain guard is never weakened, and the deploy README "multi-node unsupported" line stays until the final gate.

## Done when
PR merged; operators can see a degraded cluster from `/ready` without replicas leaving rotation; single node unchanged.
